title.narrative: Strengthening the resilience of vulnerable populations to food crises and climate stresses in South Sudan.

description.narrative: The action is a follow up and capitalizes upon previous EU funded support to food security information system. It aims at providing timely availability of quality country-wide food security, resilience and nutrition information crucial for promoting evidence based policy formulation and planning, implementing both humanitarian and development initiatives that respond directly to the needs of target communities, reducing vulnerability, food and nutrition insecurity.
